items.title: Abstract Micro-Grid Perforated Mesh File for Industrial Laser Cutting
items.description: A sleek, ultra-modern industrial vector design composed of a dense, repeating abstract micro-grid layout with a clean structural appearance. This functional perforated cutting file is meticulously prepared in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats for precision sheet metal laser cutting, punch pressing, and CNC waterjet processing. An excellent solution for fabricating high-end HVAC radiator covers, ventilation grilles, and acoustic paneling.
